name: Audience image upload
summary: The audience "attach a photo" control. The host picks, crops and hosts the file through xprops.uploadImage; this control guards the call and shows the result. A slide never uploads a file itself.
highlights: Guards a missing host, double taps and failures
Dashed card or compact button form
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-audience-image-upload> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Empty (area)
spec.value: min-height 120, 2px dashed ink edge, radius 8, frosted surface; system-image-square 24, 16px prompt, 14px format hint

spec.label: Attached
spec.value: the picture fitted (contain) in a 203px box, then Change and Delete as 48px secondary buttons

spec.label: Failed
spec.value: a 16px semibold error line (role=alert) in the DS error colour

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: uploadImage
props.desc: The host's uploader, xprops.uploadImage. Without it the control is disabled

props.name: value
props.desc: The attached image; persist `path` if it must outlive the session (the url is signed and expires)

props.name: variant
props.desc: area = the dashed card (the image is the field); button = compact, for a row with other content

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Locks the control while the form is busy or submitted

props.name: add-label / hint / change-label / remove-label / uploading-label / failed-label / preview-label
props.desc: Every string, translated by the caller

props.name: change / error
props.desc: An image attached or removed; the host call failed (also shown on screen)

whenToUse.when: the slide has image submission on and the participant attaches a photo
the presenter's settings panel, never the audience phone

opinion.note: No <input type="file">, FileReader or FormData in a slide: the host owns picking and hosting. Gate the control on the slide's image-submission setting. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font. Delete is a neutral secondary button until the DS ships an outlined danger tier (DSN-927).
